findings.title: HTTP/2 Bomb (CVE-2026-49975 Apache; companion CVEs pending) — Remote DoS Against Apache httpd / NGINX / IIS / Envoy / Cloudflare Pingora, Three Major Implementations UNPATCHED, Public PoC
findings.affected_technology: Web servers and edge proxies — Apache httpd (mod_http2, fixed in 2.0.41), NGINX (fixed in 1.29.8 with new max_headers directive), Microsoft IIS (unpatched), Envoy (unpatched), Cloudflare Pingora (unpatched)
findings.summary: A combined HPACK compression amplification and HTTP/2 flow-control stalling DoS technique discovered by OpenAI's Codex agent can crash Apache httpd, NGINX, IIS, Envoy, and Cloudflare Pingora from a single client in under a minute; Apache + NGINX patched, IIS/Envoy/Pingora unpatched with public PoC.

findings.title: Linux Kernel CVE-2022-0492 (cgroups v1 release_agent) Added to CISA KEV — Active Container-Escape Exploitation Confirmed by Kaspersky, 3-Day Federal Deadline 2026-06-05

findings.summary: CISA added the 3-year-old Linux kernel cgroup release_agent container-escape bug CVE-2022-0492 to the KEV catalog on 2026-06-02 with a 3-day federal remediation deadline of 2026-06-05 after Kaspersky published in-the-wild exploitation reporting against containerized environments.

findings.title: Visual Studio Code Unpatched Zero-Day — One-Click GitHub OAuth Token Theft via Malicious Extension Auto-Install (Full Disclosure)
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Visual Studio Code (all currently shipping versions); github.dev browser variant; GitHub OAuth tokens with full-repo-access scope
findings.summary: Researcher Ammar Askar published full disclosure of an unpatched VS Code zero-day that uses a crafted github.dev link to auto-install a malicious extension via simulated keypresses inside a sandboxed webview, exfiltrating the victim's full-scope GitHub OAuth token in one click.
